text: イワヤマ　トンネル　ぬけて　シオン　タウンに　いくはずが　いろんな　やつに　つかまるなあ…

structure.jp: イワヤマ　トンネル　ぬけて
シオン　タウンに　いくはずが
structure.en: I was supposed to go to Lavender Town, but

structure.jp: いろんな　やつに　つかまるなあ…
structure.en: I keep getting stopped by all sorts of people...

patterns.name: 〜はずだ
patterns.explanation: はず means 'supposed to'; with が after it, it means the plan did not work out that way. いくはずが = 'I was supposed to go, but...'.

patterns.name: 〜に (by whom)
patterns.span: いろんな　やつに　つかまる
patterns.explanation: つかまる means 'to get caught', and the に before it shows who does the catching. いろんな　やつに　つかまる = 'I get caught by all sorts of people'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. ぬけて = 'go through and...'.
